# Hawkerline

> Hawkerline is a source-available restaurant ordering, kitchen display, menu and POS system that an AI agent can operate, built for Singapore food businesses and running on one Cloudflare Worker and one D1 database.

Hawkerline is source-available under the Hawkerline Community License (not OSI open source). It is free for a food and beverage business to run for its own outlets when the business and its affiliates had annual revenue of not more than S$10,000,000 in the previous financial year. It was extracted from the production system of 坡晓馒 PO XIAO MAN, a Singapore bun shop.
